verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs confirm a 'Model APIs' offering for calling hosted models on shared, serverless-style endpoints without deployment (baseten-docs-1, baseten-docs-30, baseten-docs-39) with OpenAI-compatible access, rate limits, and deprecation policies for these hosted models. However, the evidence pack never names specific model families such as Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, or GPT-OSS, nor gives any indication of catalog breadth or currency. Missing for 10: an actual model catalog/list showing multiple current open-weight families, evidence of catalog size or update cadence, and independent confirmation of which models are available.
